summary: You can define your own rings and grant short-term group access, and the hybrid AD sync now heals itself.

new.title: Define your own deployment rings
new.text: Name, add or remove up to ten rings under Settings > Deployment rings. Hovering a ring shows which managed tenants it reaches.

new.title: Short-term access to another group (Pro)
new.text: In the request portal a consultant can ask for short-term membership of another group. The department approves, and it ends automatically, after 24 hours by default.

new.title: Bulk actions on Admin accounts
new.text: Select several accounts to link them to a company or department, change the auto-disable date or reset their access.

fixes.title: Hybrid AD sync no longer stalls
fixes.text: The sync can no longer stop for hours unnoticed. Watchdogs restart it, and Settings shows whether each worker job is working.

fixes.title: Same initials no longer block commits
fixes.text: The new-admin wizard now refuses an account name already in use, before anything is staged.

fixes.title: Commits explained in plain words
fixes.text: The commit dialog lists every change in plain words, and a refused commit explains why and offers buttons to fix it.

fixes.title: Smaller improvements
fixes.text: Settings are grouped in categories, some menu items moved, a single-administrator tenant can allow self-approval, and access keys can last up to 10 years.
